title: Research: rule out direct idle-cost cycles on the PR3359 map
body:
## Summary

```diff
 fixed PR3359 map, whole helpers, original calls/windows
- direct four-bin improvement unresolved
+ no direct one-out/one-in permutation lowers any concave idle-rank cost
```

Prove a scoped direct-cycle obstruction on exact PR3359 head `3bdc260e996fd3a94dcb7560b68f2c61d2253d80`. An integer hinge certificate covers four-bin rotations and, by the same telescoping proof, cycles of every length with exactly one original helper leaving and entering each affected bin. The favorable relaxation drops family and active-pair conflicts. This is a finite combinatorial theorem with a written concavity argument; no new κ or global packing optimum is claimed.

Interacting changes are outside this model. A fixed control independently reconstructs [PR3366](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3366)'s five-role witness and matching payload hash. Its shared bin loses two original width-8 helpers and gains widths 7 and 9. Its improvement is consistent with the theorem; its search, pricing and complete admission are not duplicated.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3359 leaves subsequent owner rearrangements open. After: all **9,284,615 integer inequalities** pass on the complete 720-state, 197,545-edge relaxed graph. Discrete hinges imply the result for every concave cost on ranks 0 through 48, including rank-zero bins, and hence every recursive idle moment `r^(1-a)`, `0<a<1`.
- Reconstruct all 69,120 source roles from canonical PR2169 plus 217 checked-preimage rows. Full canonical payload equals the retained PR3359 result; the independent original owner audit rebuilds all actual windows. Seven canonical runtime inputs are pinned; no pending Git object is needed.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, six normal/optimized behavioral groups, optimized Python 3.14 Git-free replay, actual typed-receipt CLI mutation, Ruff, whitespace and committed-byte/source-history preflight pass. The uncompressed synthetic oracle checks every hinge edge maximum.

Replay with standard-library Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-direct-cycle-obstruction
```

Source, proof, integer potentials, exact receipts, controls, limitations and open next questions are in `research/t16-direct-cycle-obstruction/`. Base and submission refresh are canonical `6f100d4`, priority revision 6. Fresh overlap covers 279 open PRs and 2,210 discussion records; this is not a novelty proof. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3355#discussioncomment-19008001).

No fresh full eleven-stage/native replay, supplier repricing, formal-kernel proof or independent human review is claimed. Multiple changes per bin, empty-bin paths, changed words/widths/chronology and new starting maps require separate analysis. The selected frontier and inherited supplier premises are unchanged.

Credit Pierre/hexapode's PR3359, Nick Petalas's PR3354/PR3338 and concurrent PR3366 witness, Philippe Van Velzen's PR2169, Josie Elliston's owner/window auditor, Hao Yan, Gonzalo Mier, George Lydakis, Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe and retained selected-source authors. Original notices are retained.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. One isolated research package with 15 files; no shared scientific code or selected record changes.

Blast radius: package. The source-bound one-original-departure/arrival-per-bin scope is essential. Archive intake is separate from scientific admission.
